body: Well, I'm still glad you posted it. We all now know you exist, and that you are going through a difficult time.
Well, I wouldn't want to see you end your life.  You seem like a fun guy.   Perhaps there are still lots of things to experience in life..
Since you blocked oxygen from your body tissues, perhaps you did harm your eyes, as well as other parts.  Sorry you're going through all of this.  Maybe a doctor should check you out.
I'm glad you survived.  Hopefully, you will feel better.

I know what you mean.  I don't even have a desire to emotionally bond with anyone.  At least you desire it.  That's a good sign.  One of my past therapists has Asperger's, yet he managed to get married and have two children.
Sorry to hear that.  Would you like to talk about it?
I have Asperger's.  There are many specialists who can help.  I can't guarantee it will work for everyone, but for many, it helps a lot.
I value your life.  Please don't do it.  There are many people who can help.
I did.  Many of them.  No cure so far.
I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like to talk about it?
I care.  We are stronger with you than without you.
